title: Guo Bing's view · How the annual-pass entry method changed (single actor)

sources.name: 365-Day Two-Person Annual Pass
sources.quote: Cardholders must verify both the annual pass and their fingerprints to enter the park

sources.name: WeChat Pay bill details
sources.quote: On 27 April 2019 Guo Bing paid the Safari Park a card fee of RMB 1,360 by WeChat Pay

sources.name: Annual pass entry records
sources.quote: After Guo Bing took out the two-person annual pass, the pass was used five times in total, on 27 April, 4 May, 1 June and 14 September 2019

sources.name: SMS notice (12 July 2019)
sources.quote: The annual pass system has been upgraded; users may enter the park quickly by face scan. Annual pass holders who have not yet activated facial recognition should bring their physical card to the annual pass centre to activate it

sources.name: SMS notice (17 October 2019)
sources.quote: The park's annual pass system has been upgraded to face-recognition entry and the previous fingerprint recognition has been cancelled; from today, users who have not registered facial recognition will not be able to enter the park normally

sources.name: Guo Bing's mobile phone video (26 October 2019)
sources.quote: Annual pass centre staff said the previous fingerprint method could no longer be used for entry and that anyone not registered in the face-recognition system would not get in; Guo Bing said his wife did not agree to facial recognition and asked whether the card fee could be refunded without registering

sources.name: Qianjiang Evening News report (4 November 2019)
sources.quote: I agreed to the fingerprinting, but I refuse to have my facial information collected

sources.name: First-instance judgment in this case

loc.court: Fuyang District People's Court, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

sources.quote: Without any negotiation with Guo Bing and without obtaining his consent, the Safari Park sent him an SMS stating that he would not be able to enter the park normally without registering facial recognition ... this amounted to an express indication that it would not perform the main obligations agreed in the original contract

events.label: Guo Bing buys the two-person annual pass and registers his fingerprint
events.detail: Guo Bing paid a card fee of RMB 1,360 by WeChat Pay; he and his wife gave their names and ID card numbers, had their photograph taken and registered their fingerprints; the pass was valid until 25 April 2020. The annual pass instructions then in force stated: 'Cardholders must verify both the annual pass and their fingerprints to enter the park'

events.label: Receives the 'annual pass upgraded to face scan' SMS
events.detail: The Safari Park sent a bulk SMS to annual pass holders: the annual pass system had been upgraded and users could enter the park quickly by face scan; holders who had not yet activated facial recognition should bring their physical card to the annual pass centre to activate it

events.label: Guo Bing enters the park normally on the pass (5 uses in total)
events.detail: The pass has five use records, on 27 April, 4 May, 1 June and 14 September 2019; entry by fingerprint recognition was still working at this point

events.label: The park shuts down its fingerprint gates
events.detail: The fingerprint gates at the Safari Park were shut down and the entry verification method originally agreed was in practice cancelled. This is a change in equipment status and does not involve a specific party

events.label: Receives the 'no face scan, no entry' SMS
events.detail: The Safari Park sent a bulk SMS: the park's annual pass system had been upgraded to face-recognition entry and the previous fingerprint recognition had been cancelled; from that day, users who had not registered facial recognition would not be able to enter the park normally

events.label: Talks with the park; refund demand rejected
events.summary: Asks for a card-fee refund; no agreement
events.detail: Guo Bing and a colleague went to the Safari Park to verify the face-recognition entry arrangement; annual pass centre staff said the previous fingerprint method could no longer be used for entry and that anyone not registered in the face-recognition system would not get in; Guo Bing said his wife did not agree to facial recognition and asked about refunding the card fee; the two sides reached no agreement; that day Guo Bing did not apply to enter the park and did not activate facial recognition

events.label: States his position to the press
events.detail: Qianjiang Evening News published Guo Bing's view: 'I agreed to the fingerprinting, but I refuse to have my facial information collected.' Afterwards Guo Bing did not enter the park by the 'annual pass + ID card' double verification method
